parameters.content:
TRIGGERS

• Runs automatically every day at 08:00
• Timezone: Asia/Baku
• /digest allows an on-demand run

DATA SOURCES

• Open-Meteo — Baku weather
• BBC World RSS — latest headline
• Google Sheets — daily to-do
• ZenQuotes — motivational quote

DIGEST PROCESSING

All data sources are merged into one item
and formatted as a single Markdown digest
for Telegram.

TELEGRAM OUTPUT

• Sends one formatted daily digest
• Sends a dynamic weather image
• Weather icons sourced from Xweather
• Day/night icon selected automatically
